items.source: Creates a new AfterDeleteEvent for the given Document, type and collectionName.
items.translation: 为给定的 Document、类型和集合名称创建一个新的 AfterDeleteEvent。

items.source: Event being thrown after a single or a set of documents has/have been deleted. The Document held in the event will be the query document after it has been mapped onto the domain type handled.
items.translation: 在删除单个文档或一组文档后抛出的事件。该事件中持有的Document将是映射到所处理的域类型之后的查询文档。

items.source: Martin Baumgartner, Christoph Strobl, Mark Paluch
